shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
curved or circular motifs incised on the surface
justification: Both depict human-derived imagery in shallow relief — A a multi-figure narrative scene of standing and kneeling persons with headdresses and small figures between them, B a monolithic anthropomorphic body whose back bears incised curvilinear and ring motifs. The differences dominate: A is a flat rectangular panel with a composed scene of interacting figures arranged in registers, while B is a single three-dimensional figure with isolated abstract motifs and no scene, no interaction and no comparable arrangement.
